clips.name: type
clips.prompt: A person sits on an office chair at a desk and types on a keyboard with both hands, then uses the mouse with the right hand, then types again.

clips.name: stretch
clips.prompt: A person sitting on an office chair leans back, stretches both arms up over the head and yawns, then sits forward again and rests the hands on the desk.

clips.name: eat
clips.prompt: A person sits on a chair holding a bowl in the left hand near the chest and eats from it with chopsticks in the right hand, bringing food to the mouth several times.

clips.name: sit_down
clips.prompt: A person standing in front of a chair turns around and sits down on the chair, then sits still.

clips.name: stand_up
clips.prompt: A person sitting on a chair stands up and stands still.

clips.name: idle
clips.prompt: A person stands relaxed, shifting weight from one foot to the other now and then, and looks around calmly.

clips.name: walk

clips.name: turn

clips.name: door
clips.prompt: A person reaches forward with the left hand, grabs a door handle, pulls the door open while stepping back, and lets go.

clips.name: window
clips.prompt: A person stands at a window and leans forward resting both forearms on the window sill, looking out, then looks around slowly.

clips.name: lie_back
clips.prompt: A person lies on their back on the floor holding a phone above the face with both hands and scrolls on it with the thumb.

clips.name: lie_side
clips.prompt: A person lies on their left side on the floor, knees bent, holding a phone in front of the face with the right hand and scrolling on it.

clips.name: turn_over
clips.prompt: A person sleeping on their back on the floor slowly rolls over onto their side and settles, staying asleep.

clips.name: sleep
clips.prompt: A person lies on their back on the floor asleep, breathing slowly, barely moving.
